findings.text: blocking: The candidate-count probe duplicates census.py:114-122 with a fixed 1e-12 threshold and no conditioned-Hessian filter; its 17-21 counts cannot establish the actual candidate maximum used to justify the fixed reserve.

follow-on: The 550-cell parameter checks two states that the base already reads as 3 roots and 2 saddles, and negative-control.log shows it still passes with containment-only proposals, so this parameter does not guard a 550-cell proposal regression.

follow-on: The direct-current comparator receives reading.path_weight and reading flux limits from the same read that supplies the booked current, so a wrong support or flux limit can move both sides together and leave this assertion green.

item_verdicts.diff: Ten commits from 8fb29acd to 9f5c81e5 change seven files; census.py:114-135 widens and ranks proposals, test_topology_read.py:2844-2878 adds the coarse-tie assertion, and the research document records the measurements.
item_verdicts.done_when: The base-gate-cache.log and head-gate-verified.log complete all three named files with twelve identical failure ids and zero added, but proposal_probe.py:50 does not measure the census's exact candidate predicate.
item_verdicts.goal: The brief.txt goal is saddle proposal coverage; scripts/prototypes/read_robustness/census.py:121 recovers the measured 282-cell pre-fold saddle, while the stated TCV and JT-60SA adapters remain unmeasured.
item_verdicts.manifest: The reviewed run's manifest.md names all ten commits, the base and head suite logs, the containment negative-control log, and the adapter follow-on.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest.md declares seven scoped paths, and git diff de1186f0..9f5c81e5 changes seven files within those paths.

justifications.durability: tests/equilibrium/test_topology_read.py:2868 fails at the 282-cell high offset when containment-only proposal is restored, as negative-control.log records, while the 550-cell parameter still passes that mutation.
justifications.evidence: The base-gate-cache.log and head-gate-verified.log have complete summaries and the same twelve failure ids, but proposal_probe.py:50 uses a different predicate for the capacity evidence.
justifications.fit: scripts/prototypes/read_robustness/census.py:114 uses the carrier's existing neighbour and fixed-shape JAX operations, though proposal_probe.py:50 introduces an inconsistent tolerance.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/prototypes/read_robustness/census.py:121 admits the neighbouring proposal that preserves the 282-cell saddle; docs/research/census-proposal-coverage.html:64 states the TCV and JT-60SA adapters remain unmeasured.
justifications.reuse: scripts/prototypes/read_robustness/proposal_probe.py:20 duplicates the candidate geometry owned by scripts/prototypes/read_robustness/census.py:26 instead of extending that owner, and its altered predicate changes what the count means.
justifications.scope_discipline: The seven files in the diff against de1186f0 are all under the reviewed manifest.md write_paths and serve the proposal, tests, or measured record.
